p.s: Dear Sir/Madam,
I am writting to complain about the musical show at the Circle Theatre.
Firstly, the actors who starring was not Dany Brook as it was advertised but one other actor, whose performance was very bad.
That made the show disappointing.
Secondly, the show should began at half past seven.
despite these fact the show began at a quarter to eight.
Also, there was not available tickets and after these bad musical show the restaurant of the theatre was closed.
My evening was not very pleasant as you advertised.
As a result of that I demand to have some of my money back.
Yours faithfully,
